scores.tell: The plain peach ledge and red-orange gradient wall are flat and slightly muddy, and the metal legs have hard glints. The chair itself is close to real.
Everything has a uniform lacquered-plastic gloss, and the tiled deck plus wavy stripes make it a little busy. Otherwise it is real-like.
It is a wide desert scene with the base sunk into the dunes, and the dish has crisp rivets and panel lines. The hero is not staged as an isolated object.
The crop is tight: the post runs off the bottom and the arrows nearly touch the sides. The wood grain is slightly decorative.
The purple diamond field is loud, and the glass has many sharp specular speckles. It is otherwise very close to the real mojito card.
The grey saucer is slightly flat and cool, and the bead lights are uniformly glossy. Staging matches the real cards.
The stone table is small in a wide park scene, and its flat matte painted stone has crack lines. It looks less modeled than real cards, and the trees and flowers compete with it.
The foam at the bottom is slightly busy, and the sails nearly touch the top. It reads like a real card.
Ivy, the lamp, the pot and the wreath crowd the frame edge to edge. The rendering itself matches the real window and swing cards.
A waxy blue-grey slab with a broad glossy sheen, like a plastic statue. It has no stone texture, and the cool, low-chroma hero looks pasted onto the orange backdrop.
